name: TCP UDP Port Range Calculator
description: Calculate the inclusive number of TCP or UDP port numbers in a selected numeric range.
search_intent: Count ports in a TCP or UDP port range and classify the selected range.
calculation: Inclusive port count = end port - start port + 1 when start <= end. Validate integer ports from 0 through 65535. Classification should identify whether the range lies within or crosses commonly recognized system/well-known, registered, or dynamic/private port-number bands.
limitations: This tool counts numeric port values; it does not test whether ports are open.
TCP and UDP can use the same numeric port independently.
Port registration does not guarantee that a service is actually running.
